name: Helping Out The Neighbor
source:
There are thousands of men who fantasize about their wives with another guy, but it's just a fantasy, you never act on it.
and i don't mean necessarily sex, just a simple naughty experience involving a third party would be an exciting thrill.
Something simple as a stranger or even a freind getting a gilmpse of your naked wife by accident...​
translation:
成千上万的男人都曾在脑海中幻想过妻子与别的男人亲热的画面，但那终究只是幻想，绝不会付诸行动。
而且我指的倒也未必非得是上床做爱——哪怕只是有一名局外人参与其中的小小越界刺激，也足以让人心跳加速、兴奋不已。
好比说，让某个陌生人甚至某位朋友，看似不经意地瞥见你妻子一丝不挂的酮体……
